  "text": "On Thursday, Mara found an envelope from the electricity company beneath a supermarket leaflet. Her mother used to sort the post before taking off her coat. Bills went into a blue folder; invitations stood against the clock until she answered them. Mara had inherited the clock, though not the habit. It ticked above the kitchen table, two minutes fast.

The teaspoon she wanted was in the drawer beside the cooker, the one that had resisted her for months. She tugged it open far enough to reach inside, then noticed how its front edge sat crooked against the cabinet. Perhaps something had slipped behind it. She drank her tea while it cooled, and after supper came back to look."
